text: Quick-Step is a flooring brand of the Unilin group (Unilin Flooring division), alongside Pergo and Moduleo.

source.name: Unilin: We are Unilin
source.quote: Today Unilin is a global player with a portfolio of strong brands such as Quick-Step, Pergo and Moduleo.
source.note: Page without a date; the same page shows the Unilin Flooring division carries the Quick-Step brand. Opened 2026-10-01.
